in_sanskrit.name: Kabi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sage, Poet
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kabi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Kabi means 'sage' or 'poet'. Kabi is a revered title for those who possess profound wisdom and knowledge, particularly in the areas of spirituality and poetry.

in_hindi.name: काबी
in_hindi.long_meaning: A person who is a poet or a sage.
